reviewNotes: Grower-confirmed planned availability only; half-open ends, gaps unavailable, no bridge across intervals or override of existing occupation. No fluent approval. Separate from native global-language candidate packets.

releasePairs.english: Plan separate availability windows for each growing space
releasePairs.zu: Hlela izikhathi ezihlukene zokutholakala kwendawo ngayinye yokutshala
releasePairs.st: Rera dinako tse arohaneng tsa ho fumaneha ha sebaka ka seng sa ho lema
releasePairs.ve: Vhekanyani zwifhinga zwo fhambanaho zwa u wanala ha fhethu huṅwe na huṅwe ha u lima
releasePairs.ts: Pulana minkarhi yo hambana ya ku kumeka ka ndhawu yin’wana ni yin’wana yo byala

releasePairs.english: Crop plan → Automatic plan from your estimates → Your available growing space
releasePairs.zu: Uhlelo lwezitshalo → Uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo olusekelwe ezilinganisweni zakho → Indawo yakho yokutshala etholakalayo
releasePairs.st: Moralo wa dijalo → Moralo o iketsang ho tswa ditekanyetsong tsa hao → Sebaka sa hao se fumanehang sa ho lema
releasePairs.ve: Pulane ya zwimela → Pulane ya othomethikhi i bvaho kha nyanganyelo dzaṋu → Fhethu haṋu ha u lima hu wanalaho
releasePairs.ts: Pulani ya swibyariwa → Pulani ya otomatiki leyi humaka eka mipimanyeto ya wena → Ndhawu ya wena yo byala leyi kumekaka

releasePairs.english: Add and confirm separate date intervals for a saved bed or field plot. The planner keeps gaps unavailable and each crop cycle inside one interval; existing occupations remain checked.
releasePairs.zu: Engeza futhi uqinisekise izikhathi zezinsuku ezihlukene zombhede noma isiqephu sensimu esigciniwe. Uhlelo aluzisebenzisi izikhala phakathi kwezikhathi, futhi umjikelezo ngamunye wesitshalo kufanele ungene esikhathini esisodwa; ukusetshenziswa okukhona kuyaqhubeka nokuhlolwa.
releasePairs.st: Kenya le ho netefatsa dinako tse arohaneng tsa matsatsi bakeng sa bethe kapa karolo ya tshimo e bolokilweng. Moralo ha o sebedise dikgeo pakeng tsa dinako mme potoloho ka nngwe ya sejalo e lokela ho fella ka hara nako e le nngwe; tshebediso e seng e le teng e ntse e hlahlojwa.
releasePairs.ve: Engedzani ni khwaṱhisedze zwifhinga zwo fhambanaho zwa maḓuvha zwa mubhedzi kana tshipiḓa tsha tsimu tsho vhulungwaho. Pulane a i shumisi zwikhala vhukati ha zwifhinga nahone mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe wa tshimela u tea u fhelela kha tshifhinga tshithihi; u shumiswa ho no ḓi vhaho hone hu kha ḓi sedzuluswa.
releasePairs.ts: Engetela u tlhela u tiyisisa minkarhi yo hambana ya masiku ya mubedo kumbe xiphemu xa nsimu lexi hlayisiweke. Pulani a yi tirhisi swivandla leswi nga phakathi ka minkarhi naswona xirhendzevutana xin’wana ni xin’wana xa xibyariwa xi fanele ku helela eka nkarhi wun’we; ku tirhisiwa loku nga kona ka ha kamberiwa.
